formulaPrecisionParity: Formula exports preserve original finite binary64 values and share expressions only when numeric constants match exactly. Changed literals were checked against source operands; cache changes were checked with the production evaluator, input caches, or isolated LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 calculations.

cachePrecisionParity.reference: Stored numeric values retain full Rust calculation precision. Each changed cache was checked against the previous native expectation by exact 15/17-significant-digit decimal rounding; all other XML and direct CSV outputs are unchanged. Exact CSV, ODS and reopened-XLSX values are independently covered by soffice-numeric-cell-precision-production.json.

xlsxCsvProductionParity: XLSX CSV expectations recaptured with current runSofficeFileCli public-command filesystem path, 2026-11-21; non-CSV outputs retained.
odsCsvProductionParity: Direct ODS CSV output recaptured through runSofficeFileCli; stored values are exported without formula recalculation.
publicXlsxReferences: All xlsx records capture complete output packages, status and diagnostics from runSofficeFileCli on Node 26.0.0. Other fixture sections retain their stated authority.
